sources.limitations: Verify current incumbent, mailbox and jurisdiction before use. Deliverability not tested. Do not send private records through ordinary outreach email. Address is printed in a non-government public directory; official county roster confirms the officeholder where applicable, but current direct address requires official recheck. The 211 resource directory explicitly directs abuse reports to the hotline. This is a shared agency information mailbox.
